name: @ai-ecoverse/workday
description: The workday CLI for jsh: the Workday org chart from a signed-in myworkday.com tab (find colleagues, a person's profile, management chain, team and direct reports, any supervisory organization). `pnpm add` it in /opt/user on SLICC 7, or `npm install -g` this folder to put `workday` on PATH.
